common.identity: Host owns metadata.name and metadata.namespace, exact GVK/GVR/scope, baseline and canonical YAML AST.
common.patches: Revision-scoped atomic leaf set/remove and array insert. No projected collection writeback. Existing unknown siblings, comments and exact scalars remain host-owned.
common.privacy: All annotation values protected. All parameter values protected and masked, including newly typed strings. No resolved credential reads or captures. Attachment output and inline volume source protected.
common.availability: Discovery, schema and real create/update capability required for authoring. Missing/empty/denied/absent/unavailable reference states remain distinct. Manual unresolved driver identifiers remain valid.
common.ownershipPolicy: StorageClass and VolumeAttributesClass are declarative; CSIDriver is conditional; CSINode, CSIStorageCapacity and VolumeAttachment are controller-owned. Trusted controller/system or installer evidence overrides authoring. Policy never grants RBAC permission.
common.validationBoundary: Parameter count, keys, fresh-value UTF-8 bounds, exact duration bounds and qualified identifiers validate locally. Existing masked parameter byte lengths remain unavailable; combined canonical size, string-map shape and driver semantics require authoritative schema/API validation.
common.unsupported: Unsupported guided scalar or collection shapes retain source and return a safe host fallback reason. Unknown sibling fields are not projected into mutation containers.
common.localDrafts: Invalid and partial text plus pending row builders stay local across section changes. Local errors block submission without erasing old canonical source.
common.composition: Actual base-ui Input, Select and Button through shared EditorField, EditorChoice, EditorHelp, EditorSection and ReferencePicker. No new shared primitive or per-group persistence.
common.integrationFixes: Exact fixture schema declares wildcard map leaves and collection items, without broad-parent admission. Session-keyed form state has no derived-state reset effects. Stable row IDs and path rebasing retain invalid sibling drafts during removal. Integer shape guards never stringify objects. Added guard, row-removal and session-reset regressions; checks remain parent-owned.
common.captureReason: EditorHost instructed groups to defer capture until Main completes coherent integration. Isolated actual production harness supplied under .local/resource-editor-implementation/issue-272/.

resources.interface: Create/edit; inspect locks mutation. No dynamic provisioning is an explicit choice, never a default.

fields.provisioner: Discovered CSI reference suggestions plus exact manual/unresolved identifier; immutable on edit.
fields.parameters.*: Masked exact string values, add/remove leaf controls, <=512 entries and <=256KiB UTF-8 validation; immutable on edit. Hidden values cannot be renamed/copied.
fields.reclaimPolicy: Omitted/Delete/Retain choice; immutable on edit. Omission defaults server-side to Delete; visible data-deletion consequence.
fields.allowVolumeExpansion: Omitted/enabled/disabled choice; class permission does not prove driver expansion support.
fields.mountOptions[]: Exact option-per-row text controls and add/remove; commas inside options preserved; mount failure consequence in help.
fields.allowedTopologies[].matchLabelExpression: Exact required topology key; nested OR term/AND requirement add/remove.
Structured requirement value list; commas separate Kubernetes topology label values only. Unknown term/expression siblings survive leaf edits.

resources.boundary: No implicit PV/PVC, default-class annotation or existing PV mutation. CSI schema discovery is not controller success.

resources.interface: Create; edit/inspect show immutable domain values. No v1alpha1 target.

fields.parameters.*: Required nonempty map of masked driver-specific string attributes, <=512 entries and <=256KiB UTF-8; immutable.

resources.boundary: Requires actual served version and CSI support. A new class plus a separate authorized PVC reference change applies different attributes. No PVC mutation here.

resources.interface: Create/edit only with trusted application ownership. Installer labels, owner references, Helm/Argo/Flux ownership signals or unknown ownership force inspection.

fields.metadata.name: Host identity must equal CSI GetPluginName(). No duplicate driver-name field.
fields.spec.volumeLifecycleModes[]: Explicit server-default/Persistent/Ephemeral/both choices; immutable on edit.
fields.spec.storageCapacity: Omitted/enabled/disabled; no implicit capacity report; scheduling consequence in help.
fields.spec.seLinuxMount: Omitted/enabled/disabled; requires confirmed SELinuxMountReadWriteOncePod feature and exact schema path.
fields.spec.tokenRequests[].audience: Exact text, including one optional empty audience; uniqueness validation. Embedded policy only, not a resource/token request.
fields.spec.tokenRequests[].expirationSeconds: Optional exact integer seconds, 600 through 4294967296; local invalid buffer.
fields.spec.serviceAccountTokenInSecrets: Omitted/enabled/disabled; requires token requests, confirmed CSIServiceAccountTokenSecrets and exact schema path. Last-request removal atomically clears dependent delivery setting.
fields.spec.nodeAllocatableUpdatePeriodSeconds: Optional exact int64 seconds >=10; requires confirmed MutableCSINodeAllocatableCount and exact schema path.

resources.boundary: Settings do not install a CSI driver or prove runtime capability. No service-account tokens are requested, displayed or persisted.

resources.interface: Read-only for every routed intent; no Create/Edit/Save/action.

fields.metadata.name: Node identity
fields.spec.drivers[].name: Registered CSI driver
fields.spec.drivers[].allocatable.count: Volume limit, not free capacity; omission not zero

resources.boundary: Kubelet and node-driver-registrar own registration. Missing data is not invented installation failure.

resources.interface: Provisioner-owned read-only report for every routed intent.

fields.capacity: Exact reported quantity; missing shown unknown, not zero
fields.maximumVolumeSize: Exact reported maximum or not reported
fields.nodeTopology: Omitted/null means no nodes; empty selector means all nodes

resources.boundary: No reservation, provisioning guarantee, report creation or mutation. Unset capacity blocks suitable scheduling checks rather than implying zero bytes.

resources.interface: Kubernetes intent/external-attacher status inspection for every routed intent.

fields.status.attached: Reported boolean or unknown; never invented success
fields.status.attachError/time/errorCode: Error presence plus safe timestamp/gRPC code; driver message hidden
fields.status.detachError/time/errorCode: Error presence plus safe timestamp/gRPC code; driver message hidden

resources.boundary: No manual attach/detach, status updates or ordinary creation.
